entries.reason: Optional Rust protocol/proxy cancellation-policy projection: a wrapped NOTIFICATION selects its exact matching live PLAIN request. No fixture peeler and no claim of Go automatic wrapped-request/role dispatch.

Direct private Option<RawJsonRpcId::Str(req-1)> return object and its Rust helper API.

entries.reason: The parser-error path has public ignored-malformed-notification effects; no private diagnostic, new SDK API, or error reply to a notification is manufactured.
scenarios: Plain $/cancel_request with object requestId {not:an id} cancels no active request, emits no notification reply, and leaves subsequent RPC usable. This projects the parser error through incoming_actor's ignored-notification-error path.
Exact private returned Err<crate::Error> object/diagnostic. Go has no public cancel-ID parser error-return API, and notification diagnostics are not wire responses.
